notes.title: The Little Brave release February 25th, 2025
notes.notes:
I'm thrilled to announce that the long-awaited release of The Little Brave is finally here! It's tomorrow, February 25th, on Steam. Be brave and get ready for the epic adventure with Keely!

In further updates after the release I plan to add support for several languages besides those already announced.

Support Keely on his adventure!
